record.label: Exact Gaussian-secant transport discriminator
record.summary: With every frozen parent parameter unchanged, the exact target-free Gaussian ReLU secant F(mu+eW,sigma)-F(mu,sigma) obtains 3.4708951907076616e-8 versus the tangent control 3.4709697955756664e-8. The 0.002149% improvement fails the preregistered 5% gate and the <1e-8 stretch gate. Gaussian mean-map curvature is therefore not the missing autonomous state in this form.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for exact Gaussian-secant replacement of the primary tangent transport; typed variance/covariance or materially different hidden state remains open.
